issues.description: The problem asks to output the names and the (male and female) Einwohnerzahlen for Gemeinden with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution query only selects the name column. This mismatch means the reference solution does not produce the requested Einwohnerzahlen (einwohner_m and einwohner_w), which will confuse students about the expected output columns and may cause automatic checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix:
Update the solution query to select the requested Einwohnerzahlen in addition to the name. For example:
SELECT name, einwohner_m, einwohner_w
FROM Gemeinde
WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000
This matches the problem requirement to output names and both male and female population counts.
